title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: booking the late declaration fee
content:
## When this applies
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the late declaration fee falls due from the state of an acceptance's records where its initial declaration was signed late and accepted for the sailing. The fee is settled once on such an acceptance, as one late-declaration-fee row referencing that signed declaration. This policy sets the amount of that fee.

## Business effect
Booking the fee writes one late-declaration charge, dated on the day of booking, on the acceptance's dangerous-goods account, tied to the declaration it charges, and raises the charges the acceptance owes by the amount booked.

## How it is invoked
The action is book_dg_late_declaration_fee_00f931c0, an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then called (call_agent_discoverable_tool) by the agent.

## Parameters
| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dg_id | reference number of the dangerous-goods acceptance whose declaration was late, as shown by the dangerous-goods acceptance lookup | identifier, text |
| booking_id | reference number of the booking the goods travel under, as shown on the acceptance record | identifier, text |
| submission_id | reference number of the late signed declaration being charged, as listed by the declaration lookup for the acceptance | identifier, text |
| amount_usd | the late declaration fee to book | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before the call |

## Return
The receipt lists dg_event_id (reference of the new charge), dg_id, charge_code (always late_declaration_fee), amount_usd (the fee booked, 2 decimal places) and charges_due_usd (the acceptance's outstanding dangerous-goods charges after the fee, 2 decimal places). The call has succeeded when the receipt returns the new charge reference and the booked amount. A repeated identical call writes nothing further and leaves the balance unchanged. No other outcome is defined for this action.

## Contract Q&A
- *Does the action check whether the declaration was late?* No. It records the charge and amount passed in; lateness and the amount are decided from the published rules and the records before the call.
- *Which declaration reference is passed?* The reference of the late signed declaration being charged.
